sections.h2: The one real collapse is cut diamonds, on a code that never changed

chart.title: Cut diamond exports fell from $23,511 million to $12,113 million on a stable code
chart.sub: Exports of code 71023910 (cut or worked non-industrial diamonds), $ million. FY2021-22 is absent from the value files and not interpolated.

sections.means: Code 71023910 runs continuously across all eight years with no successor code, so its decline is genuine.
sections.todo: Track cut diamond exports as the real structural decline, not the recoded lines that only look like collapses.

sections.h2: Most growing export lines grew because India shipped more, not because prices rose

chart.title: Of 3,139 growing lines, 84% grew on volume rather than price

chart.source: DGCI&S TradeStat, 8-digit HS codes, value and quantity files.

sections.means: Among comparable 8-digit lines, the direction of quantity change separates volume-led growth from price-led growth.
